about_the_game:
- FREE DOWLOAD CONTENT DLC -

What would happen if Henry Caviar chose not to help the woman on the night of the Friday 13th?

The Secret Story - Extended Edition explores alternate possibilities—an additional tale branching from the main story. It follows the protagonist, Henry Caviar, and what might have happened if he had chosen not to help the woman in front of the hotel. How would his path have changed?

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This update contains hidden details and subtle story elements, with more updates planned for the future. If you're playing The Secret Story, we highly recommend downloading this content.

And the best part? It's completely free to download!
